name: state4-short-match
note: 0000DDSS after four or more literals: 3 bytes from 2..3 KiB back, then the same opcode in its state 1..3 form: 2 bytes from 1 KiB or less back

name: first-byte-1-literals
note: opening byte 18: 1 literal(s) (state 1), then the 2-byte match that state enables

name: first-byte-2-literals
note: opening byte 19: 2 literal(s) (state 2), then the 2-byte match that state enables

name: first-byte-3-literals
note: opening byte 20: 3 literal(s) (state 3), then the 2-byte match that state enables

name: first-byte-6-literals
note: opening byte 23: 6 literals (state 4), then a 3-byte M2 match

name: m2-all-lengths
note: 128..255 with LL=0..3 (lengths 5..8) and 64..127 with L=0..1 (lengths 3..4), all at distance 8

name: eos-with-length-continuation
note: 0001HLLL with LLL=0: a length continuation byte precedes the LE16 distance that declares end of stream

name: m3-m4-trailing-literals
note: the 1..3 trailing literals of an M3 and an M4 instruction, whose count comes from the low two bits of the LE16 distance operand

name: no-name
note: a header with a zero-length filename

name: old-version
note: version below 0x0940: no versionNeeded, no level and no mtime high word

name: all-checksums
note: all four optional block checksums at once, the only configuration that pins down the order of the fields: Adler-32 then CRC-32 of the uncompressed bytes, then Adler-32 then CRC-32 of the compressed bytes

name: crc32-header-and-data
note: a CRC-32 header checksum and a CRC-32 of the uncompressed bytes, with no Adler-32 anywhere

name: method-1
note: method 1 decodes with the same LZO1X decoder as the others

name: method-2
note: method 2 decodes with the same LZO1X decoder as the others

name: method-3
note: method 3 decodes with the same LZO1X decoder as the others

name: stored-block
note: compressedSize == uncompressedSize: the payload is the data itself and must never reach the LZO1X decoder
